impact: A mega-deal that could reshape big-cap AI and tech weightings and draw flows toward Tesla; little direct effect on Clement's holdings, though it adds to the AI-and-space narrative competing for capital.
summary: SpaceX and Tesla have set up special committees to negotiate a potential all-stock combination valued at about $3.5 trillion, the FT reported: Roelof Botha and Randy Glein for SpaceX, and Robyn Denholm, Kathleen Wilson-Thompson and Jack Hartung for Tesla. Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs advise SpaceX and Evercore advises Tesla; Bloomberg earlier reported a deal could be announced as early as December. A Tesla shareholder vote and regulatory review of SpaceX defense contracts and Tesla's China exposure are hurdles.
title: SpaceX and Tesla name five directors to negotiate a possible $3.5 trillion merger
